VBO:0200531.summary: Foxhounds form a family of pack-hunting scent hounds. North American working records distinguish American, English, Penn-Marydel and Crossbred lines, preserving separate breeding histories within the shared hunting tradition.
VBO:0200531.shortDescription: Foxhounds share a pack-hunting tradition across American, English, Penn-Marydel and Crossbred lines.

sources.title: MFHA — Foxhound Registration Rules and Definitions
sources.evidence: Read rules(b)–(m), kennel-list and breeding sections: named American/English/Penn-Marydel/Crossbred categories, breeding and pack records. Harriers separately eligible but not silently recast as foxhounds.
